title: app.setBadgeCount returns false and never paints a positive dock count
body: In an Electron main process on macOS, app.setBadgeCount(1), (8), and (25) all return false. No dock badge is shown even when focused. This worked in the preceding Electron release. The problem is a missing badge for positive counts, not removing a badge.

title: Dock menu stays open after changing app menu
body: On macOS, replacing the dock context menu leaves the previously opened menu on screen until clicking elsewhere. Dock badge counts work normally.
